note: Adapted from Emerson’s 1952 original English description; holotype from Guarani, Brazil. Measurements translated verbatim from Table 26 of the original, in millimetres. The original did not describe the alate or the worker.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Close to C. bequaerti, but in this species the short hair blanket on the head is denser, the sides of the head are more narrowed anteriorly, and the notch on the anterior margin of the pronotum is more distinct.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head, pronotum and abdomen pale yellow. Vertex covered with many setae and a dense short hair blanket, with 1—2 setae and the short hair blanket below; front of the postmentum with a few setae and covered with the short hair blanket; pronotum with many setae and some short hairs; tergites with setae and many short hairs; sternites with setae and hairs. Head nearly rectangular, sides slightly curved and slightly narrowed anteriorly. Frontal tube short, slightly upturned, its tip lower than the vertex in lateral view, covering the base of the postclypeus from above. Narrowest part of the postmentum slightly wider than 1/2 to 2/3 of the greatest width (0.39—0.47:0.69—0.71 mm). Antennae 15-segmented, segments 2, 3 and 4 about equal in length, or segment 3 slightly longer than segment 2. Lateral corners of the labrum rounded, the margin between the lateral corners and the base of the white median lobe slightly convex. Anterior margin of the pronotum distinctly concave. Measurements (mm; original Table 26, n=3—19, means in parentheses): head length including mandibles 4.63—4.69 (4.65); head length to the tip of the frontal tube 2.97—3.29 (3.12); head length to the lateral mandibular bases 3.01—3.53 (3.28); head width 2.29—2.71 (2.52); head thickness 1.56—1.82 (1.73); frontal tube length 0.35—0.46 (0.40); labrum width 0.76—0.83 (0.79); left mandible length 1.53—1.60 (1.56); right mandible length from the notch 0.75—0.86 (0.81); pronotum length 0.64—0.74 (0.69); pronotum width 1.26—1.39 (1.34); hind tibia length 1.94—2.15 (2.06).
